verdict.rationale: Moosend is an email marketing platform, so an API for creating, updating and suppressing contacts with custom properties is a fair question to ask of it. Nothing in the evidence pack documents such an API. The only nearby items are no-code app integrations and billing for subscribers who sit in several lists, and neither is a developer contact-management API.

support.subject: As a developer, I can create, update, and suppress contacts with custom properties through the API at production scale
